runtime_gate.reason: No deployed runtime gate consumes the pending Z2 aggregate SOC/Tc measurement.

excluded_scope: Materials outside the locked seven-material Tiwari/C2DB reference panel
Spin models other than the frozen nearest-neighbour J and B/J analytical fits
Long-range exchange, itinerant-magnet corrections, finite-size scaling, substrate effects, and experimental Tc claims
Scalar-energy rows without SOC-resolved FM/AFM evidence
Statistical uncertainty claims beyond the published Green/MC/RNSW method envelope

premises.statement: The content-addressed Z2 panel reports complete signed magnetocrystalline-anisotropy ranking and Curie-temperature measurements from spin-resolved FM/AFM SOC evidence for at least five held-out materials.

statement: The spin-aware multi-fidelity stack exactly reproduces the signed magnetocrystalline-anisotropy ordering on the locked Z2 panel and reports Curie-temperature predictions against the published method envelope.
